does.title: Build it, host it and share it here

build.term: Build an app by saying what you need
build.detail: Describe it in plain words, and yaks.app builds it. For a new feature or a fix, ask your Operator, the AI assistant that comes with your apps, and it makes the change.

online.term: It stays online and saves what people add
online.detail: Your app lives at your own address, like %{yours}, on any phone or computer. Sign-ups, recipes, photos and files are saved for everyone you share with.

share.term: Share it with the people it's for
share.detail: Keep an app to yourself, send its link, or invite as many people as you like to view or edit it, free. Publish it, and others can get a copy of their own.

how.title: How yaks.app works

say.name: Say what you need
say.detail: Type it in the box above, like a chore chart for your household.

open.name: Open it anywhere
open.detail: yaks.app builds it and puts it online. Open it on your phone or computer, or send its link to the people it's for.

keep.name: Sign up free to keep it
keep.detail: Enter your email, and the app is yours, at your own address like %{yours}.

how.agent: Already use Claude or ChatGPT? Paste %{agent} into it, and it can build your apps too.

cost.title: Free to start, a plan for more
cost.note: A space is your address, like %{yours}, with its apps, their data and the people you invite. Your first space is free.

free.storage: 1 GB of app data, 1 GB of photos and files

plus.note: The Plus plan, for each space. Take payments with Stripe.
plus.storage: 10 GB of app data, 50 GB of photos and files

pro.note: The Pro plan, or $490 a year. Your staff ask the Operator by email or chat, and it makes the change.
pro.storage: 10 GB of app data, 50 GB of photos and files

cost.limits: Tax is included. Going over a limit never deletes your apps or data. %{plans}.

join.title: What app would you like to build?

data.site: Build, host and share web apps.
data.app: Build, host and share web apps. Say what you need, from a menu for your side business to a recipe box for your family, and yaks.app builds the app and puts it online at yourname.yaks.app, with its own data, file uploads, email address and optional custom domain. Share it with the people it is for.

features.build: Apps built from what you say you need
features.changes: Changes and fixes made by your Operator
features.assistant: Apps built by your own AI assistant over MCP
features.store: A graph data store per app, shared across devices
features.live: Live updates for everyone using an app, and voice calls
features.models: AI models and server code for apps
features.publish: Publish an app for other people to install

free.name: Free
free.offer: For one space: 5 apps, unlimited visitors, 1 GB of app data, 1 GB of photos and files, and 100 emails a month. A person's first space is free.

plus.name: Plus
plus.offer: For one space: unlimited apps, unlimited visitors, 10 GB of app data, 50 GB of photos and files, 2,500 emails a month, and a custom domain.

pro.name: Pro
pro.offer: For one space: unlimited apps, where staff ask for a change by email or chat and yaks.app makes it, document search, notices by email, AI use included, email support, unlimited visitors, 10 GB of app data, 50 GB of photos and files, 2,500 emails a month, and a custom domain. Or $490 a year.

build.name: yaks.app — describe the app you need, and it is built for you
build.title: yaks.app — describe the app you need, and it is built for you
build.description: Describe the app you need, like a sign-up sheet, a price list or a member directory, and yaks.app builds it and puts it online at its own address. Free to start.

operator.title: yaks.app — get an Operator that builds apps for you
operator.description: Get an Operator that builds apps for you. Tell it what you need, and it builds the app and puts it online at your own address.

examples.note: Your Operator can make apps like these. Open one to try it. %{gallery}.

churches.name: yaks.app for churches — a new church website built from the one you have, and changed whenever you ask
churches.title: yaks.app for churches — a new church website built from the one you have, and changed whenever you ask
churches.description: Type your church's web address and watch yaks.app build your new site from it, free to try and with no sign-up. Then change it by asking, by email or chat, and add sign-up forms, a member directory and a calendar. $49 a month for your whole church.

organizations.name: yaks.app for organizations — like having a web person on staff, for $49 a month
organizations.title: yaks.app for organizations — like having a web person on staff, for $49 a month
organizations.description: An AI assistant looks after your organization's website. Email it what you need and it makes the change, and we fix what it gets wrong. Type your website's address for a free private preview, with no sign-up. $49 a month for the whole organization.

townships.name: AI for townships — a Michigan township website that drafts the board's minutes as it meets
townships.title: AI for townships — a Michigan township website that drafts the board's minutes as it meets
townships.description: A website for a Michigan township: meetings, documents and notices, proposed minutes drafted from the meeting as it happens, and the dates the Open Meetings Act makes them due. Work out any meeting's notice and minutes deadlines on the page.

pricing.name: Pricing: your first space is free, and the Plus plan is $9 a month
pricing.title: Pricing: your first space is free, and the Plus plan is $9 a month · yaks.app
pricing.description: You pay for a space, not for people, and invite as many as you like on any plan. Your first space is free. The Plus plan is $9 a month for a space, and the Pro plan $49.
